facts.fact: Nikolai 独自立在站台之外等人群：晌午的烈日落在他赭红制服上，吸血鬼最忌正午——他们的亲王却亲自来接。
facts.anchor: He stood apart from the assembly, as he always did.

facts.fact: 他比上次见面瘦了：颧下凹陷深了一分，下颌线更削——她疑心他没进食，在等她。
facts.anchor: He’d lost weight since I last saw him.

facts.fact: 他在台阶下伸手，不给别人、不给 Aelindor、不给指挥官、更不给 Caspian——只给一个没有徽记的一年级学员。
facts.anchor: Not to anyone else. Not to Aelindor, not to the commanders, and definitely not to Caspian. To me.

facts.fact: 她看懂：他不是在守礼，是当着全站台的军官士兵把礼仪扔掉，宣告她的分量。
facts.anchor: He wasn’t following protocol. He was discarding it

facts.fact: 体内的寄居体对血族生理发表意见：尝过她血的人不会再去找别人——她听了脸更热。
facts.anchor: Once anyone tastes you, or your blood, they won’t go back for anyone else

facts.fact: Nikolai 的欢迎词是「你看起来糟透了，在外面到底睡没睡」——她一时不知怎么答。
facts.anchor: “You look like shit. Did you sleep at all out there?”

facts.fact: 上车前 Nikolai 宣布 Max 坐他的车，Caspian 立刻自请加座，两人当场斗嘴。
Drakken 留在 Greyhold 镇守东境等各堡援军，归期未定——他的缺席压在她胸口，她说不清为什么。
facts.anchor: The dragon prince had stayed behind at Greyhold to hold the eastern border until reinforcements arrived from the other forts. No estimated return.

facts.fact: 她反复说服自己「他不在反而松快」，却无法理解那份空缺为什么像疼。
facts.anchor: So why did the lack of him feel like an ache?
